title: What's happening to me...(part 1)
content: You don't know what this sub means to me, because I couldn't find anywhere to share the things that happen to me. First I apologize if it is not very well written, English is not my first language, and I hope not to make it too long. My relationship with the dream world has always been very complicated, even as a child I managed to have memories that I thought were real. I have never ever managed to have a "lucid" dream, that is, even if I am aware that I am dreaming, there is nothing What I can do to control it and I always find myself swept up in events. This usually doesn't matter to me when the dreams are good (I have very complex and detailed dreams, and it's usually like living a movie) I even enjoy them a lot, even some bad ones, but there are a couple of things that happen to me and I wanted to know if anyone more happens. 1- Nightmare levels: This would be recurring scenarios, the dream normally starts well but soon things start to get complicated. Depending on the scenario I find myself in, I can know the level of fear I am going to experience, but as I said, even if I know it is a dream, I can never manage it. There would be 3 levels from least to most terrifying: \- The labyrinth house: The interior of a house seems normal and even very pretty, but as I progress (I usually look to repair something) I find creepy rooms and something that chases me. \- The mansion at the top: I walk through a very large park in my city, all the paths lead to immense stairs that I end up climbing. At the top there is a huge, beautiful Victorian mansion, which I want to enter, as if it were calling me. That's when things get complicated. \- The cathedral: This is the worst of all. It usually starts out looking like a museum. I am usually alone and I walk through it in silence, rooms with statues, images, even a garden, until I reach a huge room that I call "the cathedral." It is huge and so high that I can't see the ceiling, in it there are statues just as big that I can't see the faces of...There is usually someone there, it always changes, but it ends up dragging me into the nightmare. I think it's taking too long, but I don't want to leave anything out, so I'll continue in another post, or in the comments. Please tell me if anything I say happens to you.
